title: K-Concatenation Maximum Sum
summary: Given an integer array and an integer k, create a new array by repeating the original array k times.
statement: Given an integer array and an integer k, create a new array by repeating the original array k times. Find the maximum sum of any sub-array in the new array, with the result modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: The empty subarray is allowed with sum zero.
hints: Kadane’s algorithm gives the best subarray in one or two copies.
For k=1, use one copy directly.
For larger k, the best boundary prefix/suffix appears within two copies; positive total copies between them can all be included.
Thus two-copy best plus max(0,total)*(k-2) covers every optimal structure.
editorial: Thus two-copy best plus max(0,total)*(k-2) covers every optimal structure.

tests.explanation: All six repeated positive values sum to nine.
Every nonempty subarray is negative, so choose the empty subarray.
